description: This file defines the StoreBackend interface, which specifies methods for verifying transactions, passwords, and enrolling public keys within a server-side authentication or security system for an Android app.

classes.name: StoreBackend
classes.description: Interface that declares methods for transaction verification, password validation, and public key enrollment.

methods.name: verify(Transaction, byte[])
methods.description: Verifies transaction authenticity by checking the signature with the user's enrolled private key.

methods.name: verify(Transaction, String)
methods.description: Verifies transaction authenticity based on the provided password.

methods.name: enroll(String, String, PublicKey)
methods.description: Enrolls a user's public key associated with their user ID and password.
